description: This PHP class, LinkRenderer, customizes link rendering for Markdown content, handling URL validation and resolution within the Daux documentation framework.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: A custom link renderer for Markdown content, handling internal, external, and broken links within the Daux framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LinkRenderer with a Daux Config object and sets up the parent renderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Processes a Markdown link node to produce an appropriately formatted link element, handling URL validation, external links, and broken links.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for the renderer, delegating to the parent renderer.
